notes: The supplied page is the Ceramics and Glass, Certificate of Achievement (Total Units 22.5-24), not the Glass, Certificate of Achievement (an 8 to fewer than 16 unit award). 'Glass, Certificate of Achievement' appears only as a navigation link in the site menu; its requirements are not in the text.

No requirements, totals, or outcomes were recorded, because the Ceramics and Glass COA content belongs to a different award. The Ceramics and Glass COA lists ARCE 1 (or ARCE 1A or ARCE 2A), ARCE 3A, ARCE 4A, ARCE 7 (1.5-3), and ARCE 11 as its required core. It also has a 9-unit elective list that includes ARCE 4B, 4C and 4D. These should not be used for the Glass COA.
The page prints five learning outcomes for the Ceramics and Glass COA. They are not copied here because they belong to that award.
A reviewer should fetch the Glass, Certificate of Achievement page (likely https://catalog.mpc.edu/programs-study/ceramics/glass-coa/ or similar) to record this award.
